role: Redundant network operations and analysis cancellation; single-link/shared-link submission flow

scope.application_commit_reviewed: e625ee7; in-progress network/runtime fixes present in working tree
additional_read: AppRoot.kt startup, analysis callbacks and pending-share wiring
AdvancedScreens.kt batch analysis and network-controls callbacks
scope.method: Read-only static control-flow review. No source edits, build, test execution, device interaction or publication.

verified_observations: analyze() synchronously marks the single-link state busy before launching; analyzeBatch() checks and sets the other busy flag, preventing concurrent submissions through these entry points.

Shared text arriving during analysis is retained in pendingShared; accepting it is blocked until both analysis busy flags clear. MainActivity removes EXTRA_TEXT after initial delivery and does not redeliver that intent on ordinary state restoration.

analyzeSource creates a fresh DirectDownloader per operation. withAnalysisCancellation cancels the owned downloader and media operation during scope cancellation and waits for guardian cleanup before returning; direct cancellation is not reset in request().

Direct analysis uses HEAD, then a byte probe only for explicit unsupported/forbidden HEAD statuses, and a normal GET only after a 416. These are explicit fallback paths, not a proven accidental duplicate submission.
limitations: No network timing, byte counts, cancellation latency or device behavior was measured.
A repeated explicit Analyze or newly accepted share may deliberately request fresh metadata; no unsupported cache requirement was treated as a defect.
The maximum-two finding requirement yielded zero proven defects in this narrow scope.
